definitions.alive_start / alive_end: birds before / after that day's events; alive_end = alive_start − mortality − culls − sexing_errors
definitions.kg: g_per_bird × alive_end / 1000 (data-model: birds alive up to that date); null g = missing (not carried over)
definitions.lay_pct: total_eggs (Cat. 1–3 + Incubabile, D18; Jos excluded) ÷ hens alive at the start of the day × 100
definitions.stock: Σ deliveries − Σ consumption per feed type since 01.03.2026 (no Hîrbovăț stock before); days_left = stock on 16.11 ÷ average consumption 13–15.11 (16.11 still being entered)
definitions.sexing_error: a bird of the other sex found in the count, removed from the recorded sex (qty −1), as in the Telița sheet
definitions.cull: Sacrificare (spec C1) with reason; BIRD_EVENT type "cull" with reason? boală / șchiopătare / altul (D36, data-model.md)
